# upsnap_user (Resource)

An UpSnap user account (`users` collection). Grant it access to devices with `upsnap_permission`. Requires superuser credentials.

UpSnap cannot return a password, so `password` is only compared with the value in state: changes made outside Terraform are not detected, and after an import the next apply sets the configured password.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "upsnap_user" "alice" {
  username = "alice"
  email    = "alice@example.com"
  password = var.alice_password
  verified = true
}

variable "alice_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Login password, at least 5 characters.
- `username` (String) Unique (case-insensitive) login name: 3-150 letters, digits, `_`, `.` or `-`, starting with a letter, digit or `_`.

### Optional

- `avatar` (Number) Index of the built-in avatar, 0-9.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `email_visibility` (Boolean) Show the email address to other users.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `verified` (Boolean) Mark the account as verified.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Record ID.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = upsnap_user.alice
  identity = {
    id = "27do0wbcuyfmbmx"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) User record ID.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The password cannot be read back, so the first apply after the import sets the configured password.
import {
  to = upsnap_user.alice
  id = "username:alice"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By record ID
terraform import upsnap_user.alice 27do0wbcuyfmbmx

# By username, which UpSnap keeps unique
terraform import upsnap_user.alice username:alice
```
